conviction_note: Q3 is pre-determined: deliveries of 118,390 are public and sit inside the RMB21.7-23.4bn guide. The stock trades on the next-quarter guide. In 3 of the last 4 prints the next-quarter guide came in below the Street, and the call reaction followed it each time (Aug 2026 -8.5% on a Q3 guide of 115-121k against ~147k expected; Mar 2026 Q1 guide of 61-66k against 84k). The Q4 bar is the company's own 'above 60,000 a month' target, which October's 50,237 already misses by 10k. That points slightly negative. Against it: overseas is on pace for the >40k target, calls are bid (skew -3.31) and the stock sits 3% above its 52-week low. Findings sum to -0.2 and the scaled number is -0.3: a near-coin-flip lean on a move expected to be large (abs 7.5).
bar: Q3 revenue consensus is about RMB23.1-23.2bn. Futu has CNY23.17B (https://news.futunn.com/en/post/1004095372/earnings-preview-xpeng-to-report-financial-results-pre-market-on, title only) and MarketBeat has $3.44bn, about RMB23.1bn (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-16-xpeng-inc-stock/, via search snippet). EarningsWhispers shows a stale ~$3.85bn that sits above the guide (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/XPEV/23063), so the bar is partly disputed. The company guided RMB21.7-23.4bn on 115-121k deliveries (6-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001810997/000119312526364050/d75446dex991.htm). EPS consensus is about -$0.11 (MarketBeat/TipRanks snippets). There is NO sourced Q4 delivery or revenue consensus. The only Q4 bar is management's own '>60,000 monthly deliveries in Q4' and '>40,000 overseas in Q4' (Q2 call, https://www.webull.com/news/15460662055355392). The Q4 findings are therefore capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest is 45.8m shares, about 4.8% of shares outstanding, with 7.36 days to cover (FINRA settlement 2026-10-30, per the sweep row citing https://equibles.com/stocks/xpev/shortinterest; not independently re-fetched). That is moderate, not crowded, but 7.4 days to cover is long enough that a positive guide can squeeze. Baseline 25d skew is -3.31 vol points (calls richer than puts), put/call open interest is 0.38 and the baseline lean is 'upside paid'. The market pays mildly for upside into a stock that is 3.0% above its 52-week low, -64.7% from its high, -9.0% over 5 days and +0.9% over 20 days. EarningsWhispers puts it -13.4% since the last report, with bullish sentiment down to 43.5% from 50.2%. Event-implied move 6.23%, straddle 8.64%.

findings.finding: The Q4 bar is management's own target of more than 60,000 deliveries a month in Q4 (Q2 call, Aug 24). October's record of 50,237 is ~10k short of that, so a Q4 delivery guide below roughly 170-180k would miss the company's own public bar. Reaching the target needs Nov+Dec around 130k (65k/month), against a Mona L05 first-month target of only 10,000 units and a domestic retail market down 27% YoY. Taken alone, this leans to a guide at or slightly below the bar the company itself set.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The next-quarter guide has decided every recent print. Aug 24 2026: Q3 guide 115-121k against ~147k expected, ADR -8.5% (36Kr, https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3955052527179398). Mar 2026: Q1 guide 61-66k against 84k street, shares up ~2% premarket on a surprise Q4 profit; the close is not sourced (search snippets). May 28 2026: Q2 guide 100-106k against 97k consensus, shares up ~3.8% premarket. Below-street guides were sold; an above-street guide was bought modestly.
findings.why_not_priced: No sourced Q4 delivery or revenue consensus exists. If the Street had re-anchored from the 60k/month talk to the October run-rate, a lowered Q4 consensus would be visible in previews. None has been published. The only sell-side move found is JPMorgan cutting its PT to $10 on Oct 26 on China demand and costs, which suggests part of it is in the price. The 5-day drop of -9% may also carry part of it.
findings.independence: Management's 60k/month and >40k overseas targets come from the Q2 call transcript (https://www.webull.com/news/15460662055355392). October's 50,237 is from CnEVPost's October deliveries report (https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/01/xpeng-deliveries-oct-2026/). The same October number is used in the overseas finding below, but that finding uses a different part of it (the overseas split).

findings.finding: October overseas deliveries were a record 13,326: up 166% YoY, up 32.5% MoM and 26.5% of the month. That exactly matches the run-rate for management's '>40,000 overseas deliveries in Q4' target (3 × 13.3k). Domestic deliveries were 36,911, about flat YoY (37,014), while China NEV retail fell 14%. The overseas half of the Q4 guide is on track, overseas units carry higher ASPs, and the Mona L05 started shipping to 65 markets on Oct 26.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 release highlighted overseas deliveries above 20k (+81% YoY) and the stock still fell 8.5% on the total-delivery guide. Overseas has not by itself moved this stock on a print.
findings.why_not_priced: The October number is public, so mostly priced. What is not visible is a Q4 overseas figure in the guide. The stock's -9% over 5 days and position near its 52-week low do not look like a market paying for overseas momentum.
findings.independence: Shares one source (the October delivery release) with the Q4-guide finding above, but uses a different line of it. Q4 overseas target: https://www.webull.com/news/15460662055355392.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue arithmetic: Q2 vehicle revenue of RMB17.05bn on 103,295 units gives an ASP of ~RMB165k. At 118,390 Q3 units that is ~RMB19.5bn of vehicle revenue (lower if the cheaper Mona L03 dilutes mix). Services were RMB2.70bn in Q2 (VW milestone-driven). The total comes to ~RMB22.3-22.9bn, about 1-3% under the ~RMB23.1-23.2bn consensus (Futu, MarketBeat) and inside the company guide of 21.7-23.4bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Reported-quarter revenue misses have not moved this name. Q1 2026 missed the Street on revenue and shares rose on the Q2 guide (May 28). The reaction belongs to the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus sits near the top of the company guide although deliveries landed only slightly above the delivery midpoint. If the Street had done the ASP arithmetic, consensus would sit near RMB22.6bn rather than 23.1bn. This lands inside the company's guide, so it is a small item.
findings.independence: Consensus RMB23.17bn: Futu preview (https://news.futunn.com/en/post/1004095372/earnings-preview-xpeng-to-report-financial-results-pre-market-on). Q3 deliveries of 118,390: https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/02/xpeng-q3-2026-results-nov-16/. The arithmetic is mine.

findings.finding: China's domestic market is collapsing into Q4. CPCA October 2026 passenger retail was 1.643m, -27% YoY and the 13th straight monthly decline. NEV retail was -14% and Jan-Oct NEV retail -13%. Exports were +68%. This domestic backdrop is what XPeng's Nov-Dec ramp to 60k/month has to come through.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: JPMorgan cut its PT to $10 on Oct 26 citing weaker China demand and higher costs (https://www.boerse-global.de/xpeng-aktie-j-p-morgan-stutzt-das-ziel-auf-10-dollar/839438). There is no measured print reaction tied to the macro series.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the series is public and the stock is near its lows. This is filed as a macro-to-company proxy. XPeng's own October domestic deliveries were flat YoY while the market fell 14%, so transmission to this company is not confirmed, and that caveat is already in the size.
findings.independence: This is a proxy. JPMorgan's demand concern points the same way (https://www.boerse-global.de/xpeng-aktie-j-p-morgan-stutzt-das-ziel-auf-10-dollar/839438). XPeng's own flat domestic October (https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/01/xpeng-deliveries-oct-2026/) points against it.

findings.finding: Vehicle margin has been stuck at 12.1% for two quarters (Q2 against 14.3% a year earlier, attributed to model changeover), and gross profit per vehicle fell to ~RMB19.9k from ~21.2k in Q1. Q3 adds the cheaper Mona L03 ramp. Peer BYD's Q3 2026 gross margin slipped to ~18.0% from ~18.9% in Q2 and it missed profit consensus (RMB10.02bn against 12.08bn expected), a sign of industry price pressure. Previews say ~13% is needed to support the transition story.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: margin flat at 12.1% and the stock fell 8.5%, but the move was attributed to the guide. Q1 2026: gross-margin expansion was credited for shares holding up despite a revenue miss.
findings.why_not_priced: No vehicle-margin consensus is published (EarningsWhispers: 'no usable per-share consensus'). A peer read is a proxy, and the +15% QoQ volume gives operating leverage that pushes the other way, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: XPeng's own Q2 margin data: 36Kr (https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3955052527179398). The ~13% margin test: EarningsWhispers (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/XPEV/23063). BYD margin calculation via Electrek (search snippet). Proxy.

findings.finding: Services and other revenue was RMB2.70bn in Q2 (+94% YoY, 75.1% margin), driven by VW technical R&D milestone achievements. That milestone-driven, lumpy line contributed most of the gap between the 20.7% group margin and the 12.1% vehicle margin. No forward guidance was given. A milestone gap in Q3 could knock 1-2 points off the group gross margin; a new milestone would hold it up. The sign is unknown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: services of RMB2.33bn (+78%) with a guide that technical cooperation revenue would be flat in Q4. No isolated reaction to this line is sourced.
findings.why_not_priced: Milestone timing is not disclosed, so nobody can price it. It is filed so judges can see the gross-margin swing factor.
findings.independence: Q2 call: no VW forward guidance (https://www.webull.com/news/15460662055355392). Electrive Sept 18 2026: XPeng plans to license beyond VW (https://www.electrive.com/2026/09/18/xpeng-to-offer-its-technology-to-additional-manufacturers-beyond-volkswagen/).

The stock is 3.0% above its 52-week low, -64.7% from the high and -13.4% since the last report, with bullish sentiment down to 43.5%. Options pay up for calls (25d skew -3.31, put/call OI 0.38). Short interest is 4.8% with 7.4 days to cover, which can extend any positive move.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: May 2026: with a low bar after a weak Q1, an above-street guide bought ~+4% premarket. Aug 2026: a high bar (147k expected) was sold 8.5%.

findings.finding: Non-auto catalysts likely on the call: XPeng's robotaxi 'YOYO' got L4 demonstration-operation approval in Guangzhou on Oct 26, the IRON humanoid is promised for scaled production by year-end 2026, and the robotics unit raised >$900m at a >$6.2bn post-money valuation. A firm IRON production start or robotaxi commercial timeline on Nov 16 would be the first update since the Q2 call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 AI Day: HK shares surged ~18% intraday on Nov 11, 2025 (https://chinaevhome.com/2025/11/11/xpeng-surges-over-18-in-hong-kong-market-cap-tops-geely/). The Aug 2026 robotics financing did not offset the guide-driven drop.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced as narrative. Only a dated production or revenue milestone would be new.

findings.finding: Cash fell from RMB47.66bn at year-end to RMB40.48bn at June 30, 2026 (42.09bn at March 31), on Q2 net loss of RMB1.34bn plus R&D up 32% YoY. The robotics unit separately raised >$900m. The money funds a record delivery ramp (Q3 +15% QoQ, October a record) and an overseas build-out to 1,200+ stores. The spending is corroborated by volume, so this is not a distress signal; the sign is zero.
findings.why_not_priced: Public. Filed so the cash-burn question is visible to judges. The answer to 'what does the money buy' is the visible ramp.
findings.independence: EarningsWhispers flags slowing cash burn as a key test (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/XPEV/23063).
